title: Mirror or paraphrase on purpose
statement: Decide on purpose whether a question repeats the text's wording or paraphrases it: a student who only matches words can answer the first but not the second.
detail: A Grade 3 standards map splits finding stated information into two components, one where the question uses wording similar to the text and one where it paraphrases or uses different words. The second names the failure it catches: a child who can find answers only when the question's words exactly match the text, and fails when synonyms or rephrasing are used. A paraphrased question needs the student to match meaning, not words.
